final_payload.rationale_summary: The comparison of growth in imports of goods and services (current US$) from 2006-12-31 to 2007-12-31 for Netherlands and Saudi Arabia was performed. The growth rates were calculated, and Saudi Arabia exhibited the higher growth. The difference between the growth rates is 8.29695463938211112780523744 percentage points.
